title: Nathan Fielder Drops Weird Trailer for Secret Elizabeth Holmes Doc ‘You Can See Everything’
content:
ByMarlow Stern

Chief Correspondent

For years, it’s been rumored thatNathan Fielderhad been interviewing Theranos founder (and certified huckster)Elizabeth Holmes— including visiting her in prison — for a top-secret documentary.

And on Sunday night, that documentary premiered at theTelluride Film Festival.

Titled “You Can See Everything,” the film is billed as follows:

Thirty-four days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss. From boundary-pushing directors Nathan Fielder andLance Oppenheimcomes ‘You Can See Everything.’

Fielder is, of course, the comedic force behind the hit series “Nathan For You” and “The Rehearsal,” while Oppenheim is the acclaimed documentary filmmaker behind “Some Kind of Heaven” and the recent Robert Pattinson-starring Chris Hansen film “Primetime,” which justpremiered to raves in Venice. “You Can See Everything” is an A24 film that will hit theaters sometime in October, and the studio also dropped a teaser-trailer for the film to coincide with its secret screening at the Colorado film fest.

The trailer sees Fielder and Holmes locking eyes intensely, sizing each other up.

“I don’t have anything to deceive you on,” Holmes tells him. “Of course I’m not deceiving you. I’m engaging with you as a human being. Why would I deceive you? There’s no reason for me to do that.”

“OK. Alright. OK, good chat,” Fielder replies, before adding, “You’re being real right now?”

“I’malwaysbeing real,” she says.
title_zh: 內森·菲爾德(Nathan Fielder)釋出了奇怪的預告片，介紹秘密的伊莉莎白·霍姆斯(Elizabeth Holmes)紀錄片《你可以看到一切》(You Can See Everything)。
content_zh:
作者：馬洛·斯特恩(Marlow Stern)

首席記者

多年來，有傳聞稱奈森·菲爾德(Nathan Fielder)一直在為一部最高機密的紀錄片採訪Theranos創始人（以及認證的騙子）伊莉莎白·霍姆斯(Elizabeth Holmes)——甚至還曾探訪她在監獄中的情況。

而在週日晚上，這部紀錄片在泰勒賴德電影節(Telluride Film Festival)首映。

影片名為《你可以看到一切》(You Can See Everything)，宣傳文案如下：

在她被送入監獄的三十四天前，臭名昭著的矽谷創始人伊莉莎白·霍姆斯邀請了一支懷疑的攝製組來記錄她的每一個動作。最初作為一位神秘罪犯的親密肖像，最終演變成一段進入深淵的思維扭曲三年旅程。這部影片來自於突破界限的導演奈森·菲爾德和蘭斯·奧本海姆(Lance Oppenheim)的合作作品《你可以看到一切》。

菲爾德當然是熱門系列《奈森為你》(Nathan For You)和《排練》(The Rehearsal)背後的喜劇力量，而奧本海姆則是備受讚譽的紀錄片導演，曾執導《某種天堂》(Some Kind of Heaven)以及最近由羅伯特·帕丁森(Robert Pattinson)主演的克里斯·漢森(Chris Hansen)電影《黃金時段》(Primetime)，該片剛在威尼斯首映並獲得好評。《你可以看到一切》是一部A24的影片，將於十月某個時候在影院上映，該工作室還發布了一支預告片，以配合其在科羅拉多電影節的秘密放映。

預告片中，菲爾德和霍姆斯目光交會，緊緊盯著對方。

“我沒有任何事情要欺騙你，”霍姆斯告訴他。“當然我不會欺騙你。我是在以一個人的身份與你互動。我為什麼要欺騙你？我沒有理由這麼做。”

“好吧。好的。好的，聊得不錯，”菲爾德回應道，隨後補充說：“你現在是真實的嗎？”

“我一直都是真實的，”她說。
